title: Eh...
text: Eh.... What is very hard to see in the picture is that these are not solid stainless cast as one piece. They have cheap plastic color bands on a separate handle and really look bad. The bag is nice enough to keep them all together and they will work for our annual fondue party. I don't expect them to have a long life expectancy.

product_metadata.title: Fox Run 11655 Set of 12 Stainless Steel 9.5" Plus Bonus Storage Bag-Color Coding Fondue Fork Silver
features: These stainless steel fondue forks are lightweight yet sturdy enough to hold up heavier fruits, meat, and brownies; perfect for a cheese or chocolate fondue Fountain party or roasting marshmallows
With heat-insulating handle, there is no distribution of heat on to the handle. The handle size is perfect to fit in the palm.
9-1/2" Fondue forks making a great distance without getting burned while cooking, with nice long body for the perfect dip and scooping of the last drop of chocolate and cheese.
12 colors help differentiate the forks between users, by color coding the forks so each person can pick their own favorite color, no more Mix up.
12 pieces fondue Fork set comes in 12 colors with convenient storage.
description: Fondue, the best thing in the whole world! Who doesn't love Fondue? Do you have any fondue forks to use? This high quality set of 12 stainless steel fondue forks, you can make your own cheese fondue, chocolate fountain at home, roast marshmallow for smores as well as dipping strawberries and chocolate and cooking meat in the fondue maker. They are sturdy enough without worrying your food falling off. Specifications: 12 X stainless steel fondue forks 12 colors for each forks, for better color coding With heat-insulating handle Overall length: 9-1/2"
